assessment: Apicomplexa parasites export proteins into their infected cells to modulate/co-opt signaling pathways for their intracellular development. This study demonstrates for the first time the export of a protein, MEDLE2, from Cryptosporidium parvum, and characterizes its targeting signal as well as its effector function in the infected host cell.
